newsitem.title: USA: NBC wins prime-time Nielsens July 14-July 20.
newsitem.headline: NBC wins prime-time Nielsens July 14-July 20.

text.p: General Electric Co's NBC network won the ratings battle for prime time viewers during the week of July 14 through July 20, with five of the top 10 prime time shows, said Nielsen Media Research Tuesday.
Westinghouse Electric Co's CBS was the second most watched network, followed by Walt Disney Co's ABC.
In fourth place was Fox Network, owned by News Corp Ltd.
NBC drew an average 7.2 rating (the percentage of the approximately 97 million American homes with television), and a 14 percent share of those actually watching primetime television.
CBS won a 6.8 rating and a 13 share.
ABC had a 6.4 rating and a 12 share.
Fox followed with a 4.7 rating and a 9 share.

The newest networks trailed the pack. The UPN network, owned by Chris-Craft Industries Inc and Viacom Inc, had a 2.5 rating and a 5 share, followed by Time Warner Inc's WB network, with a 2.1 rating and a 4 share.
Nielsen Media is owned by Cognizant Corp.
